description:
Priority: P1 (build/process). File: Makefile.toml. Reference: aviary (richest), keystore, hare.

Problem: Missing tasks the fleet relies on: monitor (Claude Code's Monitor tool invokes it), coverage/coverage-llvm-cov, generate-schema, and a blocking clippy/clippy-flow override. (CARGO_MAKE_COVERAGE_PROVIDER = "llvm-cov" already set in [env].)

Change: Add:
  - [tasks.monitor]: command = "bacon", args = ["--headless", "--summary", "--no-help-line"]
  - [tasks.coverage] (alias -> coverage-llvm-cov) and [tasks.coverage-llvm-cov] — copy from keystore/aviary
  - [tasks.generate-schema] — throwaway postgres:18-alpine + pg_dump -> tern/schema.sql (match existing pg task image). Copy from aviary.
  - [tasks.clippy-flow] (or [tasks.clippy]) override running `cargo clippy-strict` so cargo make and bacon use the same gate.

Acceptance: cargo make monitor, cargo make coverage, cargo make generate-schema all succeed; clippy task fails on warnings.
Depends on: TPL-003 (alias). Enables: TPL-015 (schema snapshot).
title: [TPL-006] Add missing cargo-make tasks (monitor/coverage/generate-schema/clippy)
